cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you go, read the final dinner bill with me. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. First I'd like us both to see what 'just a starter' cost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Let's meet your share while it's still printed clearly.

mechanism: A negotiates immediate shared bill inspection, takes calculation work and keeps B present until the precise consequence is acknowledged.
confusable: Unlike merely collecting payment, A refuses a vague later split or promise before both see the amount.
comparison: A restaurant bill and calculator differ from an allotment scale contest.
